documents.title: Receipt Of Trading Approval For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Face Value Rs. 2/- Each

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of over 700 crores for Q1 FY27, with sales volumes of 5,278 tons and a high share of value-added products at 63%. Management revised the full-year volume growth guidance to 12-15% following early trade route disruptions and noted that operations normalized starting in June. The company plans a corporate restructuring involving the formation of Tieramet Limited for its copper business through an NCLT process. Additionally, management announced a proposed capex of 40 crores over the next two financial years and targeted reaching 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30. Bhagyanagar India Limited reported its Q1FY27 financial performance with consolidated revenue from operations at Rs.

guidance.claim: The company aims to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Export contribution for the year is estimated to be between 12% and 15%.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: Management is very confident of achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching 5,000 crores in the year 2030, translating to between 20% to 25% CAGR over the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. We are, in 5 years, we are planning to... 3 years, and we are planning to double the turnover to 5,000 crores, which translates in Between 20% to 25% CAGR. 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects a minimum volume growth of 15% to 20% every year.
guidance.quote: Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year on an increased top line.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% and a 5% increase in prices out of their 25% target.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

guidance.claim: Management expects the contribution of silver and tin bearing bus bar sectors to reach about 7-10% in the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: The contribution to our top line is very, very small right now, but going forward, in the next 3 to 5 years, we hope to reach about 7-10% in the sectors.

demand_outlook.claim: India is highlighted as one of the fastest growing copper users globally, with consumption projected to reach 2.4 million metric tons by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double in the next 5 years from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market in India is estimated by some reports to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: All existing customers are looking to increase volumes and talk about doubling capacity in the next 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: As of today, we see a lot of demand. All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that world copper consumption is predicted to become 50 million tonnes by 2050.
demand_outlook.quote: The world consumed around 26 million tonne of copper, which is predicted to become 50 million tonne by 2050, so this is almost doubling.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects a big shortage of copper coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the copper business is going to explode and the market is growing much faster than competition.
demand_outlook.quote: And like we've been discussing, the copper business is going to explode like nobody's business. Advait had mentioned that we'll become the second biggest consumer of the copper in the world. So, while competition is growing, the market is growing much faster.

capex_expansion.claim: The management has proposed to execute 40 crores of capex across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finished adding an installed capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is projected for the next financial year between April and June.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year with the new 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
capex_expansion.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated value-added products reached around 62% at the end of quarter four and they plan to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43% and highest PAT margin of 2.87% for the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: We have had our highest EBITDA margin of recent times at 5.43%, our highest PAT margin of 2.87%.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieved its highest value-added products share at 63% and highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: Primary copper refining charges have gone negative because available ore and concentrate flow to China.
margins_costs.quote: You know, the refining charges in primary copper have gone negative, because whatever ore and concentrate is available in the world is all going to China.

margins_costs.claim: Removal of customs duty from 1st January 2025 helped the company increase its margins.
margins_costs.quote: Also, the customs duty has been removed from 1st January 2025, so that has also helped us increase our margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that silver-bearing and tin-bearing bus bars will give roughly about 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that passing on additional EBITDA per tonne is a stretch and the pass-on is typically only for the price increase, not the additional margin.
margins_costs.quote: However. Passing on the additional EBITDA per tonne is a little bit of a stretch, and for that, we need to get into more and more value-added products, either on the finished goods side, or to ensure that our backward integration becomes more efficient in terms of recycling our material in a much better way. The pass-on is typically only for the price increase, not the additional margin.

margins_costs.claim: Management considers 4.5% to 5% a good EBITDA margin for the business they are in.
margins_costs.quote: The business which we are in. 4.5% to 5% is a good EBITDA margin, and we hope to maintain and try to keep it closer to 5% rather than, anywhere else.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volumes for the quarter came down to 5,200 tons, of which 2,200 tons were achieved in the month of June.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons. But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: In the transformer division, the company recently added Crompton Greaves, TMC, and Atlanta as customers.
orders_capacity.quote: If you take a look, we have added Crompton Greaves, TMC and Atlanta in the transformer division in recent times

orders_capacity.claim: CTC wire capacity is about 80 metric tons a month and will increase to 150 metric tons a month.
orders_capacity.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume grew by 34% last year to 24,000 metric tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, with quarter four achieving around 62 rupees per kg.
orders_capacity.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards. With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

capital_allocation.claim: The company finalized the first round of fund raising at 52 crores, with the money expected in the bank in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of fund raising will likely occur around March after the demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected debt in 2030 is estimated between 300 and 325 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: Total fund raise from the preferential issue is Rs. 52.25 Crores.
Management is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages in the first two months caused turnover to come down.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: A GST demand and input credit reversal of 17 crores was imposed due to retrospective registration cancellation of a scrap supplier.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that scrap coming from the Gulf has suddenly dried up and shipping lines have been diverted.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up. And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the company's dependence on scrap from the Gulf is less than 5% of their material.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are dependent on scrap from Gulf to less than 5% of our material comes from Gulf.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposes to incur 40 crores of capex.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company will execute a complete digital transformation of all processes, departments, and reporting automatically.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

management_commitments.quote: That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030. management_commitments.claim: Management aims to increase value-added products up to 66% by the end of next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

management_commitments.quote: We can go back to the questions. And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: Management hopes to complete the fundraise of roughly 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.
